description: Sends a contact request by email to Swiss Premium Insurance (contact@sp-insurance.ch) on behalf of a person who asked to be contacted about an offer. Input: the comparison_id, the insurer chosen, the person’s email address or phone number, and client_consent, which states that the person agreed to this transfer. Returns a receipt with a reference. The receipt means the email service accepted the message; it is not an insurance contract and it does not cancel the current insurance. The same request sent again with the same request_id within 24 hours does not send a second email.

inputSchema.description: The comparison_id of a comparison, the insurer chosen, the person’s contact details and their agreement.

agent.description: Optional. Who is calling; self-declared, used for statistics only.

name.description: Name of the assistant or product making the call.

client_consent.description: true when the person has agreed that their contact details, the comparison criteria and the chosen offer are sent to Swiss Premium Insurance. The request is refused without it.

comparison_id.description: comparison_id from the quote; valid 30 days. Preferred.

contact.description: The person’s own details: an email address or a phone number, and optionally a name and a message.

email.description: Email address such as client@example.ch; an empty string or an omitted key means a phone number is given instead.

phone.description: Telephone, 8-15 digits, optional spaces and + country code; an empty string or an omitted key means an email address is given instead.

insurer_id.description: insurer_id of the chosen offer, from offers[].

language.description: Language of the person; defaults to the comparison language. fr, de, it, en have localised texts and pages; es, pt, zh are recorded for SPI (preview and pages fall back to en/fr).

offer_id.description: offers[].offer_id or source_offer_id; alternative to insurer_id.

request_id.description: Identifier of this request, as returned by the comparison (any UUID is accepted). The same request sent again with the same identifier within 24 hours is not sent twice.

subsidy_requested.description: The person wants information on premium subsidies.

supplementary_interest.description: The person also wants offers for supplementary insurance (LCA).

name: request_adviser_contact

switching.description: Dates of the ordinary change of insurer for the tariff year.

window.description: open until the end of the deadline day in Switzerland, closed afterwards.

wording.description: Optional sentences validated by the broker, in the language requested.

cancellation_deadline.description: Present while the switching window is open.

help.description: The broker’s free help; present with a comparison.

title: Send a contact request to Swiss Premium Insurance
